public_boundary.registration: explicit caller-side as_register_provider_v0 only; no installed registry entry

report.canonical: sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan false, no trailing newline

invariants: Fixed v0 format only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160 samples. No adapter-sized variant is defined; the installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
The C provider is task-local, OFF by default and unregistered. ON requires explicit caller-side registration on one registry.
Every synthetic feedback-path case reports all 12 required metrics for identity and −3/−5/−8 dB bounded-gain controls; no result is omitted.
Missing, malformed, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong-shape, stale-epoch and wrong-position inputs fail explicitly with DSP state unchanged.
Gain is bounded to the configured range at create and on each frame; there is no adaptation, detector, room model or physical-loop claim.
Stability labels are simulator-only proxies for explicit FIR delay/IR/gain trials, never room or device claims.
All material is synthetic and model-free. No real audio, trained model, licensed runtime, listening, MOS/STOI, target pacing, CPU/deadline, benchmark or release claim is made.
Canonical report and output digests are byte-identical when regenerated from the pinned fixture.
release_gates: Measured loudspeaker/microphone paths with pinned IRs, calibrated gain-before-feedback, delay drift, path changes and amplifier saturation
Held-out speech and music with authorized perceptual/intelligibility review
Target runtime latency, CPU/memory and deadline qualification
Provider intake, license/notice, descriptor and public catalog review
Benchmark bundle creation and validation under the current submission policy
